expectedComments: Explain the AS-facing contract, selected inputs, exact observations, and the important ownership/boundary rule for: Returns the navigation direction carried by the event. Returns how navigation was initiated. Returns the analog magnitude carried by the event. Returns the platform user associated with the event. Returns the input device that produced the event. Returns the key associated with the event. Returns the platform key code carried by the event. Returns the cause of the focus transition. Returns the Slate user associated with the focus event. Reports whether the event was generated by key repeat.
expectedObservations: Consume every non-void result and compare its exact semantic value. Exercise both true and false outcomes unless the API contract documents a single reachable result.
inputs: Known positive and negative receiver states, empty/default state, exact lookup keys, and boundary values implied by the listed signatures.
testScope: EUINavigation Navigation = NavigationEvent.GetNavigationType() const; | ENavigationGenesis Genesis = NavigationEvent.GetNavigationGenesis() const; | float32 Value = AnalogInputEvent.GetAnalogValue() const; | FPlatformUserId PlatformUser = AnalogInputEvent.GetPlatformUserid() const; | FInputDeviceId InputDevice = AnalogInputEvent.GetInputDeviceId() const; | FKey Key = AnalogInputEvent.GetKey() const; | uint32 Value = AnalogInputEvent.GetKeyCode() const; | EFocusCause Cause = FocusEvent.GetCause() const; | uint32 Value = FocusEvent.GetUser() const; | bool bResult = CharacterEvent.IsRepeat() const;
